content:
maria: Quick cross-team check — runtime perf sprint sync. Posting async: where we are on kernel patch, continuous-batch rollout, KV cache warmup. TL;DR: need owners for canary tomorrow, dependency on infra autoscaler, and a CR review blocker. @aj @liam please.

aj: Kernel patch PR #4321 ready, awaiting perf tests. Ran local bench: ~18% p99 reduction on long seq. Perf logs: https://redwood.perf/reports/4321

liam: Continuous batching canary is staged in qa cluster. Need ~2h to fix shard imbalance (seeing ~7% tail skew). Working on balancing script. @sophia can you check the rollout policy in console?

sophia: On it. Updating rollout to ramp 10% -> 50% over 2h. Proposed snippet:
```
rollout: { steps: [10, 50], step_interval: "1h" }
```

aj: Kernel PR needs kernel-team approval from @maria for compatibility with KV prefetch. CI shows failures on coldstart only.

maria: I'll review in ~30m. State of KV prefetch: @devops?

infra-bot: autoscaler forecast: predicted capacity shortage for canary at 10% traffic in us-west-2. Recommend bumping reserved nodes +2. /cc @devops :warning:

devops: Ack — adding +2 nodes to k8s pool, ETA ~20m. I'll comment on the canary once done.

liam: Note: need to toggle `kv_warmup=true` in canary config or tail latency will spike. Adding a small patch in PR #987.

sophia: CR pinged @maria @aj — left a comment about prefetch ordering. Might affect latency for short requests.

maria: Acknowledged. Prefer prefetch for sequences >128 tokens only. Suggest config `prefetch_threshold=128`.

aj: Agree. Will make it conditional and push a commit.

sophia: Quick ask: are we measuring per-route token breakdown? If not, can we add a metric `route.token_ms` for quick regression detection?

devex-bot: New dashboard created: /dashboards/runtime-prefetch-route-breakdown — ETA 1h. Added basic panels for p50/p95/p99 per route.

maria: Final ask: owners for rollback plan? If canary crosses 2x baseline error or p99 increases >15% -> rollback. Owners: @liam rollout, @aj kernel revert, @sophia monitoring.

liam: I'll own rollout + rollback.

aj: I'll prepare revert branch and a hotfix checklist.

sophia: I'll add alert rules and a short incident runbook (link when ready).

maria: Thanks all. If anyone hits blocking CRs or infra issues drop a note here. I'll post a short follow-up after review. :thumbsup:
